marketplace_snapshot.reading: sparse (cone mode) keeps root-level files plus .agents/ and packaging/; the SNAPSHOT keeps its .git/ (the install does not); no plans/

ref_release.reading: --ref release installs release's tree; the default branch carried a REHEARSAL_MASTER_ONLY marker that did not appear

no_ref.reading: without --ref the default branch (HEAD) is installed; config.toml then records no ref

marketplace_upgrade.reading: upgrade re-resolves the pinned ref (config keeps ref = "release") AND rewrites the installed 0.1.0 directory in place with the new tree, before any second `plugin add`: a same-version content change reaches an upgrading user
